hero_lede: A quiet home for notes, longer writing, and a direct way to reach me. Made to read well on a phone and on a large screen.
about_title: A personal site, kept on purpose.
about_body: I'm Faisal Hanif. This is the public face of my work on the web: writing I want to keep, and the places I can actually be reached. The site is also the tool I use to publish it.
about_point_1_body: The interface is in English and Indonesian. Published writing stays in one list, either way.
about_point_2_body: Notes stay private while they are drafts. Published pieces appear here no matter which language the page is in.
about_point_3_body: Email, LinkedIn, and GitHub are the channels I check. There is no public registration on this site.
work_body: The project I am shipping here is the site itself: a public portfolio and blog, with a private editor for the person who writes it.
work_site_body: Portfolio, blog, and studio. Drafts, publishing, and a rich-text editor, with the interface in two languages.
work_linkedin_body: The professional profile, if that is the better introduction.
contact_body: Email is the fastest way to reach me. I also read messages on LinkedIn.
blog_lede: Writing published from the studio. The same posts appear in either language.
blog_empty_body: Published writing will show up here. Drafts stay in the studio until they are ready.
login_lede: This entrance is for editing the site. There is no public registration.
studio_lede: Drafts, published notes, and the editor.
analytics_lede: How people find the site, how long they stay with a post, and what they open.
analytics_impressions_hint: Times a published post was opened.
analytics_unique_hint: Distinct hashed browser fingerprints. This is not a name or an account.
analytics_read_hint: Average is total reading time divided by visitors who actually stayed to read.
analytics_interest_hint: Clicks from the homepage toward GitHub, LinkedIn, or email.
analytics_empty: No visits in this period yet.
empty_studio_body: Try another filter, or start a new draft.
field_excerpt_hint: Shown on cards. Leave it blank to use the opening of the post.
editor_hint: Shortcuts like # for headings and ** for bold work while you type. Drop an image or video into the text to upload it.
delete_body: This removes the draft or the published page. It cannot be undone.
toast_link_invalid: Enter a valid http, https, mailto, or site link.
toast_upload_failed: The upload did not finish. Try again.
toast_upload_type: Use a JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, MP4, WebM, or MOV file.
toast_upload_large: That file is too large. Images can be 12 MB, videos 80 MB.
error_body: The link may be old, or the post is still a draft.
